method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Dow futures hit three-month low as yields surge, Micron earnings offer support
Equities.reason: Broad market equity negative: rising yields and bond-driven risk-off dominate the headline despite a constructive Micron print. This is a market-regime signal (rates squeezing equities) with high relevance to overall risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
Equities.summary: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.
Equities.reason: High-impact earnings reinforcing the AI leadership / semiconductor demand narrative. Micron’s blowout results and guidance materially support tech-sector upside and capex/demand expectations for memory vendors.

Equities.title: Volatility control funds near record equity exposure, raising selloff risk
Equities.reason: Systemic market structure risk: elevated equity exposure in volatility-control strategies increases potential for forced de-risking in a market downturn, amplifying selloff risk for broad equities.

Equities.title: Investors wary of slowdown in US corporate profit boom
Equities.reason: Macro/fundamental negative: signs that the corporate profit impulse that supported markets may be slowing would weigh on equity multiples and risk appetite across sectors.

Equities.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced AI model
Equities.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Alphabet's most advanced model yet, with major coding, cybersecurity, and complex professional work improvements.
Equities.reason: Positive for AI leadership and tech capex/demand: a major new model from Alphabet strengthens the AI growth narrative that underpins big-cap tech and AI supply-chain beneficiaries.

Equities.title: Stocks Rise as Tech Strength Weathers Bond Swings: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market-resilience signal: tech outperformance cushioning broader market volatility from bond moves — supports a nuanced risk-on tilt concentrated in large-cap tech.

Equities.title: South Korean shares end nearly 2% higher on record chip exports
Equities.reason: Regional/sector confirmation: strong chip export data bolsters semiconductor demand narrative and supports Asian tech equities, reinforcing the global AI/semiconductor theme.

Equities.title: OpenAI’s agents obscured hacking activity in government site breaches
Equities.summary: New findings by Asymmetric Security provide further evidence of novel tactics AI tools use to conduct hacks
Equities.reason: Reputational/regulatory negative for AI-exposed names: evidence of AI misuse raises governance and regulatory risk for the AI sector, a modest headwind to investor sentiment toward tech leaders.

Rates.title: VIEW Bond markets take a drubbing again, 10-year Treasury yields highest since 2002.
Rates.reason: Broad global bond rout with 10-year Treasuries at multi-decade highs — clear negative signal for bond prices/rates (yields up). High relevance as this is a market-wide rates narrative driving positioning and risk pricing.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
Rates.summary: Treasury yields were higher on Thursday amid a global sell-off in government debt.
Rates.reason: Confirmation that US yields are driving a global selloff and hitting multi-decade highs — negative for bonds and suggests higher-for-longer policy/repricing of rate path.

Rates.title: Global bond sell-off pushes 10-year Treasury yield to highest since 2002
Rates.summary: Sovereign debt costs around world return to multiyear highs
Rates.reason: Authoritative confirmation of a broad sovereign yield repricing — significant negative for bond markets and indicative of rising term premia and tighter financial conditions.

Rates.title: US Treasuries: Long-end selloff extends to multi-decade highs – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid describes severe stress in US Treasuries, with 10-year and 30-year yields pushing to post-2000s highs despite dovish PCE revisions.
Rates.reason: Selloff concentrated in the long end and highlighted by a major bank — indicates rising term premia and market skepticism about imminent policy easing; negative for bond prices and long-duration positions.

Rates.title: Global Bonds: Selloff deepens with rising term premia – BBH
Rates.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad highlights a deepening global bond market selloff driven by tighter expected policy paths and rising real term premia.
Rates.reason: Analysis tying the selloff to higher expected policy paths and rising real term premia — reinforces narrative of structurally higher yields and broader negative implications for bond portfolios.

Rates.title: Bond selloff could mean outsized portfolio changes at quarter's end
Rates.reason: Practical market impact piece: the selloff is forcing portfolio rebalancing and could amplify flows; negative for bond market liquidity and prices in the near term, but somewhat narrower/operational focus.

Rates.title: Fed's Kashkari: Will put pressure on different parts of economy if we keep raising rates
Rates.summary: Minneapolis Federal Reserve (Fed) President Neel Kashkari told Bloomberg on Thursday that if they keep raising rates, they will put different pressure on different parts of the economy, per Reuters.
Rates.reason: Fed official signaling willingness to keep rates higher to damp demand — dovetails with market repricing toward higher-for-longer policy and is negative for bond prices (yields up).

FX.title: British Pound tests 1.3200 as higher US yields and risk-off markets boost US Dollar
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) heads lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with the GBP/USD pair hitting three-month lows just below 1.3200 ahead of the US session opening.
FX.reason: Explicit USD-driven move in GBP/USD as US yields and risk-off pressures push the Dollar higher. Direct USD pair move — medium relevance to FX regime.

FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) extends losses for the fourth consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD), reaching levels below 1.1300 for the first time since May 2025.
FX.reason: EUR weakness vs USD is driven by rising US yields and risk factors — strong, clear USD-dominant FX signal. High relevance given sustained multi-day move to yearly lows.

FX.reason: Bank research highlights continued USD upside despite cooler inflation — reinforces market's USD/yield-driven narrative. Important for near-term FX direction.

FX.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Early Morning Reid notes that softer US PCE revisions reduced expectations for an October Fed hike, even as the Dollar Index edged higher.
FX.reason: Analysis flags Fed repricing and mixed data but still notes DXY edging higher — a nuanced USD-positive signal. Relevance moderate because it balances data and positioning.

FX.title: Why is the US Dollar climbing when its preferred inflation gauge is cooling?
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) continues to display underlying strength, with the US Dollar Index (DXY) touching its June year-to-date high near 101.80 despite recent data showing a deceleration in core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation.
FX.reason: Piece directly addresses the apparent paradox of USD strength amid cooler PCE — reinforces narrative that yields/positioning outweigh near-term CPI signals. Useful to FX positioning context.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: USD/JPY rises as October BoJ hike bets fade – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman reports the Japanese Yen has weakened about 0.5% against the US Dollar, lifting USD/JPY to 158.44, after the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) Summary of Opinions disappointed expectations for an October rate hike.
FX.reason: Clear USD/JPY move tied to fading BoJ hike bets — direct USD-strength transmission via a major G10 pair. Relevant to broader dollar/FX dynamics.

FX.title: Euro slides to 17-month low, hit by rates and inflation cocktail
FX.reason: Major wire report noting euro at multi-month lows on higher yields and inflation dynamics — high-impact FX news that supports the dominant USD-strength regime and positioning flows.

FX.title: US Dollar: Resilient growth supports upside risks – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad highlights a resilient US economy underpinning Dollar strength, with the DXY at new cyclical highs. Upward revisions to US Q2 GDP and strong Q3 estimates from the Atlanta Fed GDPNow model support the constructive outlook.
FX.reason: Research note ties stronger US growth to DXY upside — reinforces macro justification for USD strength and yield differentials driving FX.

FX.title: Euro: French spread widening threatens EUR/USD range – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner flags that EUR/USD has been driven to yearly lows mainly by a hawkish reassessment of Federal Reserve policy, but warns French OAT‑Bund spread widening is an emerging concern.

FX.reason: Research note expects range-bound USD/JPY despite recent strength — relevant to positioning but lower relevance than macro flow pieces.

FX.reason: Intervention absence is a direct FX flow/market structure signal supporting further JPY weakness and USD strength — straight FX relevance.

FX.reason: Major wire on BoJ comment effect lowering hike bets and weakening JPY — significant for USD/JPY and global FX risk dynamics.

FX.reason: Reports of positioning flows (hedge funds boosting euro shorts) amplify FX market impact of euro weakness and USD demand — elevated relevance due to flow amplification.

FX.reason: FX-native note pointing to idiosyncratic KRW strength on fundamentals (exports/AI-led semiconductor boom). USD-centric impact is secondary, so relevance is modest and direction is KRW-positive.

FX.summary: Japan's Prime Minister said her government's policies will lift confidence in the yen, following underwhelming success in prior efforts to boost the currency.
FX.reason: Official comments aim to bolster JPY confidence after limited intervention success — directly FX-relevant and could counter USD strength if credible; medium relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Fed-backed strength holds near yearly highs – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes the Dollar remains strongly supported, with the DXY index near its highs for the year as solid US activity data reinforces the Federal Reserve’s hawkish stance. He highlights resilient consumer spending, signs of accelerating payrolls
FX.reason: Bank commentary linking robust US activity to DXY strength — reinforces the core theme (Fed/backed USD strength) and is directly relevant to FX positioning.

Commodities.title: Gold struggles as rising US Treasury yields outweigh dovish Fed repricing
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) treads water on Thursday as a stronger US Dollar (USD) and soaring US Treasury yields limit the upside. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,167, up 0.26% on the day, as the precious metal struggles to build on its early recovery.
Commodities.reason: Direct gold price piece. Stronger USD and rising US Treasury/yields are cited as the cap on bullion — classic negative pressure for precious metals (higher real yields/USD). Clear, commodity-specific signal so moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold inches higher as softer US inflation dims October Fed hike bets
Commodities.reason: Reuters note signals a near-term bullish impulse for gold as softer US inflation reduces near-term Fed hike odds. Important macro cross-link (inflation -> policy -> real yields) so positive for bullion with above-average relevance.

Commodities.reason: Operational shift by Indian refiners to alter shipping/routes across Hormuz signals persistent geopolitical/logistical friction in a major oil transit corridor — modestly bullish for oil risk premia and market structure.

Commodities.reason: Major strikes on Ukraine's energy infrastructure increase European energy security risk ahead of winter, supporting gas and broader energy commodity risk premia. Relevant to commodity markets given demand/supply and seasonal timing.

Commodities.title: Trump 'thinking about' diesel export ban, but says it could have 'negative impact' on gasoline

Commodities.reason: Potential US diesel export restrictions would tighten domestic product availability and influence spreads/flows — bullish for US product prices and relevant to crude/product markets, but still policy-talk so moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Henry Hub natural gas prices this summer were 6% lower than last summer
